title: Internal Error (Power LED 1 Red Blink)
shortDescription: Single red blink indicates an internal circuit fault.
fullDescription:
Epson projectors signal errors via the power LED blink pattern. One red blink typically indicates an internal error, often a main board or power supply issue.

Unplug the projector for 10 minutes and retry. If the error persists, the unit needs service.
symptoms: Single red blink on power LED

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug projector for 10 minutes, then try again.

fixSteps.title: Contact service
fixSteps.instruction: If error persists, contact Epson authorized service.

whenToCallPro: Always - internal board faults require service.
videoSearchQuery: Epson projector 1 red blink internal error fix

title: Lamp Error (2 Red Blinks)
shortDescription: Two red blinks indicate a lamp problem.
fullDescription:
Two red blinks on the power LED mean the lamp has failed, is near end of life, or is not installed correctly.

Replace the lamp with the correct Epson OEM part and reset the lamp timer in the menu.

fixSteps.title: Cool down
fixSteps.instruction: Let projector cool for 30+ minutes before opening.

fixSteps.title: Reseat lamp
fixSteps.instruction: Open lamp cover, remove and reseat lamp.

fixSteps.title: Replace lamp
fixSteps.instruction: Install new OEM lamp if reseating fails, reset lamp hours.

whenToCallPro: If new lamp doesn't resolve the error.
videoSearchQuery: Epson projector 2 red blinks lamp replacement

faq.a: Check your model's ELPLP part number.

title: Temperature Error (3 Red Blinks)
shortDescription: Three red blinks indicate the projector is overheating.
fullDescription:
Internal temperature exceeded safe limits. Usually caused by blocked vents, clogged filter, or high ambient temperature.

Clean filters, improve ventilation, and ensure at least 20cm clearance around all vents.

fixSteps.title: Clean filter
fixSteps.instruction: Remove air filter and vacuum or replace.

whenToCallPro: If cleaned filter and good ventilation don't resolve.
videoSearchQuery: Epson projector 3 red blinks overheating fix

title: Fan Error (4 Red Blinks)
shortDescription: Four red blinks indicate a fan failure.
fullDescription:
Internal cooling fan has failed or is obstructed. Projector will not operate without functional cooling.

Often requires fan replacement by a technician.

fixSteps.title: Listen for fan
fixSteps.instruction: Power on and listen for fan startup.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Contact Epson service for fan replacement.

videoSearchQuery: Epson projector 4 red blinks fan error

faq.q: Can I just clean the fan?
faq.a: Try compressed air first, but usually needs replacement.

title: Lamp Failure Message
shortDescription: The projector reports lamp failure on screen.
fullDescription:
On-screen lamp error indicates the lamp has reached end of life or has burned out.

Replace with OEM Epson ELPLP lamp and reset the lamp timer.

fixSteps.title: Order lamp
fixSteps.instruction: Find correct ELPLP number for your model.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Install per Epson manual, reset lamp hours.

title: High Internal Temperature
shortDescription: Warning that internal temperature is rising.
fullDescription:
The projector warns before shutdown when internal temp rises toward safe limits.

Clean filter and improve airflow immediately to prevent auto shutoff.

fixSteps.title: Improve airflow
fixSteps.instruction: Move projector to cooler space, ensure vent clearance.

title: Cooling Fan Error
shortDescription: Fan RPM out of range or failed.
fullDescription:
The fan speed sensor reports abnormal RPM. Unit will shut down to protect the lamp.

Most cases require service to replace the fan assembly.

faq.a: Depends on projector age and value.

title: Lens Cover / A/V Mute Slide Closed
shortDescription: The A/V mute slide or lens cover is closed.
fullDescription:
Many Epson models have a sliding lens cover that doubles as A/V mute. Closed cover produces no image.

Simply open the slide to resume normal operation.

fixSteps.title: Open slide
fixSteps.instruction: Slide lens cover to open position.

videoSearchQuery: Epson projector lens cover av mute slide

title: Clean Air Filter Warning
shortDescription: The air filter needs cleaning or replacement.
fullDescription:
Based on operating hours and sensor readings, the projector warns you to clean the filter.

Remove, vacuum, or replace the filter and reset the warning in the menu.

fixSteps.title: Clean/replace
fixSteps.instruction: Vacuum or replace. Reset timer in menu.

title: USB Device Not Recognized
shortDescription: The USB source cannot be read.
fullDescription:
Projector can't read the attached USB drive or device. Usually caused by unsupported format or power issues.

Use FAT32-formatted USB with supported file types (JPG, MPEG).

fixSteps.title: Format FAT32
fixSteps.instruction: Format USB drive as FAT32 on a computer.

fixSteps.title: Use supported files
fixSteps.instruction: Load only JPEG, MPEG, or supported formats.

title: HDMI No Signal
shortDescription: HDMI input lost or handshake failed.
fullDescription:
Projector detects the cable but no valid video signal. Usually HDCP handshake or cable issues.

Try a different cable, reseat connections, and power cycle both devices.

fixSteps.title: Reseat cable
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug both ends and firmly reseat.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Power off both devices, unplug 30 sec, reconnect.

videoSearchQuery: Epson projector HDMI no signal fix

title: Power Cable Disconnected / Error
shortDescription: No power detected or insecure cable.
fullDescription:
Projector doesn't power on because power cable is loose, damaged, or outlet is dead.

Check all connections and try a different outlet.

fixSteps.title: Reseat cable
fixSteps.instruction: Firmly reseat cable at both ends.

fixSteps.title: Test outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Try a different outlet with known-good device.
